Name: Stardew 3DVR - Play Stardew Valley in Full VR With Motion Controls
Author: GingasVR
Description:
[size=4][b][color=#00ffff]Play Stardew Valley as a real 3D world, on your monitor or in VR[/color].[/b] This is a WIP mod but is Fully Playable, there will be some visual weirdness, but it won't mess up your save and you can install or Uninstall this at any point. You can also seamlessly switch between 3D mode, VR mode or back to 2D with Hotkeys. [/size]

[size=4][youtube]Bv7ZgCPmLt8[/youtube][/size]

[color=#ffff00][size=5] [/size][/color][b][size=5][color=#ffff00]Requirements[/color][/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] [/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/*]
[*]For VR a SteamVR or OpenXR Headset (e.g Valve Index, Quest Etc) 
[color=#00ffff][size=4]You do NOT need a VR Headset to play this. It's fully Playable as just a desktop 3D port of Stardew Valley[/size][/color][/*]
[/list][size=5][color=#ffff00][b] Install[/b][/color][/size]
[size=3]- Drop the Stardew3D folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder like any other mod[/size]
[size=3]- Launch the game through SMAPI like any modded setup.[/size]
[size=3]- Alternatively you can use a Mod Manager (Mo2, Vortex etc)[/size]

[color=#ffff00][size=5][b]Hotkeys - Can be changed in the Mod Config Menu[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3][color=#ffffff]F5 - 3D Mode (Flatscreen,first-person, WASD)[/color][color=#ffffff] Same controls as normal [/color][color=#ffffff]Stardew [/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#ffffff]F8 - VR Mode (headset must be connected first, full rework of controls for steamvr and openxr (check below)[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#ffffff]F9 - recenter VR view[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#ffffff]F10 - toggle the wrist HUD (left controller) [/color][/size]
[color=#ffffff][size=3][size=3]F7 - dump debug info to the SMAPI console - use this for bug reports[/size][/size][/color]

[color=#00ffff][size=4]You can Hotswap between 2D/3D and VR Seameasly at any point. [/size][/color]

[color=#ffff00][size=5][b]VR Setup[/b][/size][/color]

[b][color=#00ffff]Vive / Index / any SteamVR headset:[/color][/b][color=#ffffff] just have SteamVR running and press F8 in-game, the default runtime is SteamVR.[/color]

[color=#00ffff][b]Quest (Virtual Desktop or Link):[/b][/color][color=#ffffff] in the GMCM menu, top section "VR Runtime", [/color][color=#00ffff]turn ON Use OpenXR runtime,[/color][color=#ffffff] then restart the game. This runs the headset directly through VDXR/Oculus with no SteamVR needed.[/color]
[color=#00ffff]Make sure Virtual Desktop's OpenXR runtime is set to VDXR.[/color]

[size=4][color=#00ffff]Steamvr runtime with quest headsets  (e.g Steamlink) [/color][color=#00ffff]don't work. [/color][color=#ffffff](At least on my system) [/color][color=#00ffff]Use only OpenXR With Quest.[/color][/size]

[size=5]
[color=#ffff00][b]VR Controls[/b][/color][/size]
[color=#ffffff][size=3]Left Thumbstick   - walk [/size][/color]
[color=#ffffff][size=3]Right Thumbstick  - turn[/size][/color]
[color=#ffffff]Right Trigger - Use tool / attack (hold to charge) [/color]
[color=#ffffff]Left Trigger - Interact / talk / open doors [/color]
[color=#ffffff]A right / A left - next / previous toolbar slot [/color]
[color=#ffffff]B right - shift toolbar row[/color]
[color=#ffffff]B left - open/close menu[/color]
[color=#ffffff]Swing Right Hand -  melee swing or Use motion control tool (gesture)[/color]

[color=#ffffff]Menus float in front of you - point with the right controller, trigger = click, grip = right-click. [/color]

[color=#00ffff]Smooth Turn is on by default, you can switch to snap in the mod config menu[/color]

[color=#ffffff]Fishing is motion-controlled: jerk the rod up to hook, then raise/lower your hand to keep the fish in the bar (watch the gauge on your left wrist). [/color]

[size=5][color=#ffff00][b]VR Render Settings[/b][/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#00ffff]True 3D (Heavy Performance)[/color][color=#ffffff] - Procedurally makes objects and buildings into voxel models, crops/trees become cross-plane renders. GPU-heavy but creates a kind of "Fake 3D" effect. Turn this off to improve framerate. There's also Culling Effects on by default and you can play with this to improve performance.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#ffffff]Cutscene view - how story scenes play: First person, Third person, or 2D screen (VR shows them on a theater screen, [/color][color=#00ffff]3rd person seems to look best for VR and 3D), I would not recommend 1st person. It's a little bit weird, but it works.[/color][/size]

[color=#ffffff][size=3]Motion fishing speed - lower = smoother bar movement. [/size][/color]

[color=#ffffff][size=3]OpenXR / SteamVR hand pitch & yaw -  if tools feel angled wrong in your hands, adjust these [/size][/color]

[color=#ffffff][size=3]World-locked tracking - Semi Roomscale. you'll need to recenter (F9) occasionally since it's not tracked yet if you check this on. [/size][/color]

[b][color=#ffff00][size=5]Building/Placing Objects? [/size][/color][/b]
[color=#ffffff][size=3]Sort of works.. but honestly it's probably easier to do this in normal 2D mode[/size][/color]

[b][color=#ffff00][size=5][b]Modded Setups, Expansions other Mod Compatibly[/b] [/size][/color][/b]
[color=#00ffff][b]You can add this on top of your normal Modded Stardew Setup[/b].[/color][color=#ffffff] It should Work.. although I have not tested all expansions or Modded Content. [/color]
[color=#00ffff][b]I actually encourage you to use other expansion mods[/b][/color][color=#ffffff][b]. [/b]I want this to work on all mod setups. There may be bugs but I'm trying to make this work with everything[/color][color=#ffffff]. [/color]

[color=#ffffff]So if you see something weird report it in the bug section and press F7/Send me your sampi logs with a screenshot of the problem[/color]

[color=#ffffff][b]The only mod that is known to be incompatible with this is[/b][/color][color=#00ffff] Clear Glasses. [/color]

[color=#ffff00][size=5][b]Reporting Bugs[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#ffffff][size=3]Upload your SMAPI log to [url=https://smapi.io/log]https://smapi.io/log[/url] and copy the link, Screenshot would also be helpful if you can get one.[/size][/color]

[color=#ffff00][size=5][b]Known Issues[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3][color=#00ffff]- Edges of map (going from 1 map to another) will look weird or might not render full in True 3D mode[/color][/size]

[color=#ffffff]- Some map decorations render flat or in odd places on heavily modded maps[/color]

[color=#ffffff]- Some Arcade Games don't work in 3D mode if they need WSAD, better to switch to 2D mode for thoes, Should be playable in VR though.[/color]

[color=#ffffff]- [/color][color=#00ffff]Floating objects, weird invisible sections of walls, objects standing upright when they shouldn't [/color][color=#ffffff]- due to the way I'm rendering this (using sprite data and not making models from scratch) things are sometimes going to look weird and there's not a whole lot I can do about it except workarounds with coding, I'm Slowey working through them but send me annoying bugs in the bug section[/color]

[b][color=#ffff00][size=5]Caveats[/size][/color][/b]
[color=#00ffff][i]Will you add full 3D Models made from Scratch?[/i] [/color]
[color=#ffffff]Right now I want to try and make this mod [b]lightweight, Streamlined and compatible with as many modding setups as possible[/b][/color]
[color=#ffffff]So[/color][color=#00ffff] I do not have plans on adding full 3D models from scratch[/color][color=#ffffff] as that would inevitably limit compatibly. [/color]

[i][color=#00ffff]Why does this look weird[/color][/i]
[color=#ffffff]Because I'm trying to hack a 2D game into 3D VR, it'll look weird, but from what I've tested it's pretty fun so far.[/color]


[color=#ffffff]There is another [b]Extremely Talented Mod Creator[/b] who's making a similar mod and I believe is [i]modeling the entire map by hand[/i] which looks incredible, [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iu7igZ3JNtU&t=1s]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iu7igZ3JNtU&t=1s[/url] Please support their project as well![/color]

Manifest.Name: Stardew3D
Manifest.Description: Proof-of-concept 3D renderer: reconstructs the 2D world as a perspective 3D diorama with billboarded sprites. Toggle with F5, camera mode with F6. First person has mouse look + FPS controls. F8 = SteamVR mode, F9 = recenter.
Manifest.Author: GingasVR
